title: Stay Off the Boardwalk Until He PASSES 🏮
description:
In our seaside town, forty old lamps light up on the boardwalk every night, one by one, and nobody sets foot on it until the Lamp Man has passed. Nobody has ever seen him up close. They say he's nine feet tall.

Tonight my grandpa's bed was empty at eight, so I went out looking for him.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment LAMP if you'd have stayed on the boardwalk too.
